about: Mutants of compiler/check/providing, the self-hosted checker's providing check (S3-PROVIDES). The agreement with the Go checker over the negative fixtures and the seeded clauses (TestCompilerProvidesAgreesWithChecker) kills each.

mutants.name: prov-own-count-unchecked
mutants.rule: A providing function's type parameters beyond its first parameter's match the operation's own in count (types.md, Interface assignability 8).

mutants.name: prov-errors-subset-flipped
mutants.to: if held(s, x, fv, we, wv) {
mutants.rule: A providing function may fail only with what the operation's error row holds (Interface assignability 1).

mutants.name: prov-uses-unchecked
mutants.rule: A providing function needs no capability the operation's row does not hold (README Gap 17).

mutants.name: prov-missing-method-ok
mutants.rule: A claimant has a function for every operation of the operation type it claims (Interface assignability 1).

mutants.name: prov-mut-receiver-ok
mutants.rule: A function on mut T provides only an operation marked mut (Generics 2; MODES-4).

mutants.name: prov-entry-undeclared-ok
mutants.rule: A context entry's provider declares that it implements the capability (Interface assignability 1; rows.md, Context 2).

mutants.name: constraint-only-value-admitted
mutants.from: if d.Generic { Some{Value: d} } else { None }
mutants.rule: An operation type with a generic operation is a constraint and has no values (Interface assignability 8).
